title: The COLLINS and EFS restore interface, the prior status value and its recording field are not published, and no requirement ID is mapped to FEAT-TRT-09
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E3-009 AC1 to AC3, Data and Endpoints tables); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3.md (A2.9.1 to A2.9.4.4); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2.md (T3.1, T4, T5.1, T8, T-A.1); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4.md (R-RES-17, R-RES-18, R-RES-20); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3.md (FEAT-TRT-09); _work/msr/context/S2.md (ownership rows of S2 and the connection matrix row of S2); 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md (R5.5 DP-05 and DP-16; R9)
section: APP s3 Preconditions; s4 Flow steps 4 and 5; s8 BR3, BR4, BR5; s11 Data; s12.2, s12.8; s13 Configuration; s14; s18 Traceability; CON s3 Preconditions; s11 Data; s12.2
description: The legacy criteria say the case is returned to the status it held in COLLINS, the FSD gives the integration points as COLLINS and Workbench and the routing logic gives the systems of R-RES-17 and R-RES-18 as COLLINS, EFS and Workbench, and no source publishes how that write is reached after the split: the ownership rows of S2 name four REST operations, one table, one event and one workflow and no integration row, the connection matrix row of S2 carries no outside cell, and TSD S2 T5.1 lists ALS and NLEADS only with no restore operation and no error set. The prior status and the restore reference have no column in TSD S2 T3.1, no BR Field ID in the Logical Data Model and no field on the treatment read, and TSD S2 T8 maps REQ-S2-001 to REQ-S2-010 to FEAT-TRT-01 and none to FEAT-TRT-09, so the requirement row of both stories is a placeholder. The two stories therefore consume the case answer of rwb-case for the prior status and the restore operation of rwb-integration for the outward write, name neither operation because no source names one, and fake both.
evidence: Context pack S2 ownership rows: four REST operations, one table, one event, zero jobs, one workflow, and no consumed row; TSD S2 T5.1 lists INT-03 ALS and INT-26 NLEADS only; TSD S2 T3.1 defines treatment DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033 with no prior-status and no restore-reference column; TSD S2 T8 maps ten requirements to FEAT-TRT-01; FSD S2 A2.9.2 gives the integration points as COLLINS and Workbench with no operation; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-RES-17 and R-RES-18 give the systems COLLINS, EFS and Workbench and no call type.
area: Integration, data and traceability, S2 rwb-treatment
owner_role: rwb-integration owner with the rwb-case owner and the business owner of module S2
proposed: The rwb-integration owner publishes the restore operation with its request, answer, error set and idempotency key, the rwb-case owner publishes the prior status as a field of the case answer, and the requirement owner maps one requirement to FEAT-TRT-09. Until then both stories hold the placeholder and build against their fakes.

title: The contract identifiers, the publication channel and the two rows' operation names and error sets are not published
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2.md (T3.1, T5.1, T8, T-A.1, T-A.2); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Logical Data Model and Data Dictionary v8.md (logic DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033 as cited by TSD S2 T3.1); _work/msr/context/S2.md (ownership rows of S2); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3.md (A2.9.3.1, A2.9.4.1); 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md (R7.2 s12, R9)
section: CON s3 Preconditions; s11 Data; s12.1, s12.2, s12.8; s13 Solution plan; s14
description: The contract publishes an element whose fields have no BR Field ID, an artefact whose coordinates and publication channel are named by no source, and two consumed rows whose operation names, parameter sets and error sets are named by no source either. TSD S2 T-A.2 gives request and answer type names for the four S2 operations only and no schema for a restore element, the Logical Data Model has no prior-status or restore-reference group, and no document names a contract publication channel for the service. The contract is therefore published as the working read of ASM-B2-S2-004-1 and ASM-B2-S2-004-3, with the field names, the coordinates and the operation names held as placeholders until the owners publish them.
evidence: TSD S2 T-A.1 lists API-S2-001 to API-S2-004 and T-A.2 gives their purpose, request, response, errors, authorization and idempotency, with no restore element and no prior-status field; TSD S2 T3.1 gives treatment columns only; no source names a contract channel for a service; the ownership rows of S2 name no consumed operation and no integration row.
area: Contract and data identifiers, S2 rwb-treatment
owner_role: Contract owner of rwb-treatment with the rwb-integration owner and the rwb-case owner
proposed: The Data owner allocates the element's BR Field IDs, the service owner names the contract publication channel, and the two row owners publish the operation names and the error sets at the wave 2 contract freeze; the element then moves from the placeholder to the identifiers with no change to its fields.
